answer: Admission proof-of-work at the gate: each identity must burn a unique puzzle, 500 CPU-hours minimum, recomputed per epoch. A spiral difficulty curve doubles the target every 1,000 admissions, so 10,000 sybils cost ~$12,000 in cloud compute versus $0 for one honest node. A falcon-scout pre-check rejects recycled nonces and rented GPU farms. The nebula of fresh wallets still pays the same escalating toll. Cost scales superlinearly, payoff stays flat—farming dies before break-even.
